rows.definition: cmd/fak/cachevalue_status.go SessionImpact (json session_impact): a short human string describing how one cache-value component affects the current session's economics.
rows.distinction: A cache-value REPORT FIELD describing economic impact - NOT SessionMeta (session identity) and NOT the session runtime object itself; it is descriptive text, not a control surface.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/resume_watchdog_cli.go sessionLive: reports whether any live OS process's command line names the given session id - the resume-watchdog's liveness check.
rows.distinction: A LIVENESS PROBE (is a process for this session still running?) - NOT SessionMeta (static identity) and NOT sessionStartSHA (the base git ref); it answers running-vs-dead, not identity.

rows.definition: internal/guardcorpus/guardcorpus.go SessionMeta: the out-of-band session identity the CLI shell resolves (session id, start info) and carries alongside a guard corpus record.
rows.distinction: The STATIC identity record for a session - NOT sessionLive (a runtime liveness probe) and NOT SessionImpact (a cache-value impact string).

rows.definition: internal/session/compactaudit.go CompactSessionReport: one rollout file's compaction health - the per-session summary of what a compaction dropped/kept during that session.
rows.distinction: A per-SESSION compaction-health record - NOT RenderCompactAudit (the renderer that prints it) and NOT SessionMeta (session identity).

rows.definition: internal/session/ctlrefuse.go: the refuse-reason STRING VALUE ("CONTROL_SESSION_TERMINAL") returned when a control write is attempted against a session that has already reached a terminal state.
rows.distinction: The reason STRING VALUE emitted on refusal - NOT ReasonControlSessionTerminal (the Go const IDENTIFIER that holds it); one is the wire token, the other is the symbol.

rows.definition: internal/session/ctlrefuse.go ReasonControlSessionTerminal: the Go const IDENTIFIER bound to the "CONTROL_SESSION_TERMINAL" refuse reason for control writes against a terminal session.
rows.distinction: The Go const SYMBOL - NOT CONTROL_SESSION_TERMINAL (its emitted string value) and NOT controlSessionTerminal the act; it is the name code references, not the wire value.

rows.definition: internal/model/qwen35_hal.go ensureOpenBackendSession: reopens the model HAL backend session when it was closed, re-panicking a stored HAL failure so a dead backend never serves silently.
rows.distinction: A MODEL-BACKEND HAL session reopen - NOT a fak agent session; it manages the inference backend's compute handle, not a conversation/turn session.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/dojo_provider_levers.go loadProviderTurnsSessions: loads the recorded provider-turn audit sessions ([]sessionaudit.Session) that the dojo provider-lever analysis folds over.
rows.distinction: A LOADER of recorded audit sessions (past turns) - NOT a live session object and NOT SessionMeta (single identity); it returns a corpus for offline analysis.

rows.definition: internal/executionroute/executionroute.go SessionFork (SessionAction "fork"): the routing decision to FORK a copyable belief-state session into a twin for a look-ahead rollout, rather than continue or reset it.
rows.distinction: A route ACTION value that forks a session into a twin - NOT a resume/continue action and NOT SessionMeta (identity); it names a branch in the execution-route decision.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/accounts_headroom.go: env knob giving the minimum per-account session headroom fraction the fleet keeps free before it stops launching new sessions on that account.
rows.distinction: A FLEET session-HEADROOM floor (accounts_headroom) - NOT a single session's config and NOT WT_SESSION (an OS terminal marker); it governs account admission, not one session's runtime.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/whats_changed.go + usage.go: env knob giving the git ref a session started from, used as the default 'since' base for `fak whats-changed` / usage diffs (falls back to HEAD when unset).
rows.distinction: The session's git BASE-REF for change diffs - NOT sessionStartSHA (the func that computes it) and NOT FAK_FLEET_SESSION_MIN (a headroom floor); it anchors a diff, not admission.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_resolve.go + guard_split.go: the Windows Terminal environment marker fak's guard-split detection reads to decide whether an attended launch is inside a terminal multiplexer (so it can open the info pane).
rows.distinction: An OS/terminal ENV marker (is this a WT multiplexer?) - NOT a fak agent session and NOT FAK_FLEET_SESSION_MIN; it detects a terminal, not a conversation.

rows.definition: cmd/qwen35check/acceptance.go + internal/ggufload: the Unsloth HuggingFace org whose *-GGUF repos (e.g. unsloth/Qwen3.6-27B-GGUF) supply the acceptance-checkpoint quants, including UD mixes that use IQ3_XXS/IQ4_XS/Q8_0 beside the K-quants.
rows.distinction: An upstream MODEL-QUANT PROVIDER org name - NOT any fak session concept; it names where a GGUF checkpoint comes from, unrelated to session runtime despite co-occurring in tooling.
